name: tamaclaude
description: Tamaclaude: a herdr plugin and a Claude Code mod with little pixel monsters, token usage charts and palettes.

scripts.check: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs --check && claude plugin validate claude && herdr config check
scripts.test: node scripts/sync-shared.mjs --check && node --test tests/*.test.mjs && claude plugin test claude && node scripts/security-check.mjs && node scripts/bench.mjs
scripts.test:unit: node --test tests/*.test.mjs && claude plugin test claude
